alerts.title: SMS asking you to 'update' your government account via a link
redFlags: Link is not on an official .gov.sa domain
Urgent threat such as account suspension or a fine
Asks for card details or a one-time code
alerts.whatToDo: Do not click. Open the official app or type the official address yourself. Never share a one-time code.
alerts.officialReporting: Report through official channels listed on the authority's website.

alerts.title: WhatsApp job offer that asks for a fee to process visa or documents
redFlags: Payment requested before a contract appears on Qiwa
Recruiter refuses a video call or office visit
Salary far above market for the role
alerts.whatToDo: Verify the employer and contract on Qiwa. Do not pay recruitment fees to individuals.
